properties.comment: Fayette Electric is aware of a power outage southeast of Cistern off St Hwy 95.

Fayette Electric crews are taking a clearance east of La Grange on St Hwy 71 to safely change out a pole. Power will be out from 9:00am to 12:00pm. We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation in this matter. For questions please call our office at 979-968-3181.
